---
title: "NCAAW 2025 Player Impact with PIDs"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Inputs

```{r paths}
# Expect to run from the players directory
pid_path <- "pid_map.csv"
master_path <- file.path("..", "2025", "master_boxscore.csv")

if (!file.exists(pid_path)) {
  stop(sprintf("Missing pid mapping: %s", pid_path))
}
if (!file.exists(master_path)) {
  stop(sprintf("Missing master boxscore: %s", master_path))
}
```

## Add PIDs to the 2025 master boxscore

```{r add-pids}
pid_map <- read.csv(pid_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
box <- read.csv(master_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Match by team + player to preserve boxscore ordering
key_map <- paste(pid_map$team, pid_map$player, sep = "||")
key_box <- paste(box$team, box$player, sep = "||")
box$pid <- pid_map$pid[match(key_box, key_map)]

missing_pids <- sum(is.na(box$pid))
missing_pids
```

```{r write-boxscore}
boxscore_with_pid_path <- "master_boxscore_2025_with_pid.csv"
write.csv(box, boxscore_with_pid_path, row.names = FALSE)
boxscore_with_pid_path
```

## Build a player impact table

```{r impact-setup}
parse_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", x))
}

impact_source <- box
if ("table_type" %in% names(box)) {
  basic_rows <- box[box$table_type == "basic", ]
  if (nrow(basic_rows) > 0) {
    impact_source <- basic_rows
  }
}

impact_cols <- c("MP", "PTS", "TRB", "AST", "STL", "BLK", "TOV")
missing_cols <- setdiff(impact_cols, names(impact_source))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(sprintf("Missing columns in boxscore: %s", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}

for (col in impact_cols) {
  impact_source[[col]] <- parse_num(impact_source[[col]])
}
```

```{r impact-aggregate}
player_totals <- aggregate(
  impact_source[impact_cols],
  by = list(team = impact_source$team, player = impact_source$player, pid = impact_source$pid),
  FUN = sum,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

team_totals <- aggregate(
  player_totals[impact_cols],
  by = list(team = player_totals$team),
  FUN = sum,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

impact <- merge(player_totals, team_totals, by = "team", suffixes = c("", "_team"), sort = FALSE)

share <- function(x, denom) ifelse(denom > 0, x / denom, NA_real_)
impact$mp_share <- share(impact$MP, impact$MP_team)
impact$pts_share <- share(impact$PTS, impact$PTS_team)
impact$trb_share <- share(impact$TRB, impact$TRB_team)
impact$ast_share <- share(impact$AST, impact$AST_team)
impact$stl_share <- share(impact$STL, impact$STL_team)
impact$blk_share <- share(impact$BLK, impact$BLK_team)
impact$tov_share <- share(impact$TOV, impact$TOV_team)

# Impact score: minutes + scoring + playmaking/rebounding + defensive events - turnovers
impact$impact_score <- (
  0.45 * impact$mp_share +
    0.25 * impact$pts_share +
    0.10 * impact$trb_share +
    0.10 * impact$ast_share +
    0.05 * impact$stl_share +
    0.05 * impact$blk_share -
    0.05 * impact$tov_share
)

impact <- impact[order(impact$team, -impact$impact_score), ]
```

```{r impact-output}
impact_path <- "player_impact_2025.csv"
write.csv(impact, impact_path, row.names = FALSE)
impact_path
```

```{r impact-preview}
head(impact, 20)
```

```{r top-players}
# Top 5 players by impact per team
split_by_team <- split(impact, impact$team)
impact_top5 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split_by_team, function(df) head(df, 5)))
head(impact_top5, 20)
```
